title: Repayment Agreements on a Home-Site Lease: Eligibility and Standing Terms
content:
A repayment agreement on the Home-Site Lease spreads a past-due lease balance over installments and is the resident's own signed undertaking.

**Who may enter one**

- **Status.** A repayment agreement is available only on an active lease; a lease in default or with a notice to vacate pending cannot enter one. The status is read from the lease record.
- **Tenure.** A repayment agreement requires the lot class's repayment tenure in full calendar months of tenancy counted from the move-in date on the lease record. Tenancy months are counted on the calendar from the move-in date, and the requirement is met on the day the last required month completes.
- **Frequency.** No more than the lot class's limit of agreements may be signed in the trailing 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, counted by the date each agreement was signed.
- **Size.** The past-due balance covered may not exceed the lot class's largest-balance multiple multiplied by the monthly site rent; a larger balance is not eligible at all.

**Down payment and installments — no longer in force.** The former clause by which at least the lot class's minimum down-payment percentage of the past-due balance, rounded half up to the cent, is paid on the signing date and the rest is split into at most the lot class's most installments in equal monthly installments due on the rent due day starting the next month, the last installment absorbing any rounding difference, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the down payment and the installments.

**While an agreement runs**

- While installments are paid on time, no late fee and no nonpayment notice is issued for the covered balance; current rent must still be paid on time.
- A missed installment ends the agreement, and the whole remaining covered balance is then treated as past due under the nonpayment process.

**Boundaries (hypothetical figures)**

| Test | Just inside | Just outside |
|---|---|---|
| Size, on a monthly site rent of 700.00 and a multiple of 2.0 | covered balance 1,400.00 — eligible | covered balance 1,400.01 — not eligible at all |
| Tenure of six months, move-in 31 August 2025 | handling on 28 February 2026 — met, the sixth month completing on the last day of the shorter month | handling on 27 February 2026 — not met |

**Status table**

| Lease status | Repayment agreement |
|---|---|
| active | available, subject to tenure, frequency and size |
| notice to vacate pending | not available |
| in default | not available |

superseded_clauses: At least payment_plan_min_down_pct percent of the past-due balance, rounded half up to the cent, is paid on the signing date, and the rest is split into at most payment_plan_max_installments equal monthly installments due on the rent due day starting the next month, the last installment absorbing any rounding difference.
